Script to Video 1.0.0 — initial release:

- Instantly converts scripts (TXT, DOCX, PDF, or plain text) into narrated AI-generated videos.
- Supports uploads up to 500MB and exports high-quality 1080p MP4 videos.
- Designed for marketers, creators, and educators to streamline text-to-video production without manual editing.
- Automated setup: free token generation and seamless session management with the processing API.
- Supports common video formats (mp4, mov, avi, etc.), session-based editing, and credit balance checks.
- Fast cloud rendering pipeline for quick turnaround (typically 1–2 minutes per clip).
